sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You combine Fire and Earth Release Chakra before releasing a stream of lava in a cone in front of you. All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 Fire and 1d10 Earth damage and being Molten on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and damage by 1d10 of each damage type. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cone by +10 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, change the chape of this jutsu to a 40-foot cube, originating from you.
